work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 擊蒙要訣 序 서 · Preface (1577) · 序 1

items.text: Be loving to your children.
items.quote: 爲父當慈 — A father should be loving.

items.text: Be filial to your parents, honoring and serving them.
items.quote: 爲子當孝 — A son should be filial.

items.text: Keep the proper distinction and order between husband and wife.
items.quote: 爲夫婦當別 — Husband and wife should be distinct.

items.text: Love your brothers with brotherly affection.
items.quote: 爲兄弟當友 — Brothers should be friendly.

items.text: Respect your elders.
items.quote: 爲少者當敬長 — The young should respect elders.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 擊蒙要訣 3 · 持身章第三 지신장 · Conducting Oneself · 持身章 1 … 持身章 16

items.text: When called before an elder, hasten to him; do not insist on measured, heavy steps.
items.quote: 足容重。（不輕擧也。若趨于尊長之前。則不可拘此。） — If hastening before an elder, do not be bound by this.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 擊蒙要訣 4 · 讀書章第四 독서장 · Reading Books · 讀書章 1 … 讀書章 13

items.text: Serve your parents with all diligence, studying and practicing the way of filial piety.
items.quote: 事親敬兄忠君弟長隆師親友之道，一一詳玩而力行之。 — In the way of serving parents, respecting elder brothers, loyalty to the ruler, deferring to elders, honoring teachers, and befriending friends, study each carefully and practice it diligently.

items.text: Respect your elder brother, studying and practicing the way of fraternal respect.
items.quote: 事親敬兄忠君弟長隆師親友之道，一一詳玩而力行之。 — In the way of serving parents, respecting elder brothers, loyalty to the ruler, deferring to elders, honoring teachers, and befriending friends, study each carefully and practice it diligently.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 擊蒙要訣 10 · 處世章第十 처세장 · Conduct in the World · 處世章 1 … 處世章 3

items.text: Teach your son to prepare for the civil examinations, for apart from them there is no other road to office.
items.quote: 父敎其子 — Fathers teach their sons.

items.text: Urge your younger brother to study for the civil examinations.
items.quote: 兄勉其弟 — Elder brothers encourage their younger brothers.

items.text: Work with your own hands for your parents, even to plowing or carrying rice, and fulfill a child's duty.
items.quote: 爲親任勞。旣修子職 — Work hard for parents, fulfilling a son's duty.

items.text: Take the civil examinations, for that is what your parents desire.
items.quote: 科業一事。是親情之所欲 — The exam studies alone are what their parents desire.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 祭儀鈔 · 告事儀 · Rite of Announcing Events · 祭儀鈔 告事儀 1 … 祭儀鈔 告事儀 4

items.text: Announce to the ancestors all significant events—appointments, degradations, exam success, school admission—with offerings, bows, and prayer, following the first-day rite.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 告事儀 1
items.quote: 有事則告。如朔參之儀。獻酒再拜訖。 — When there is an event, announce it; follow the first-day rite; offer wine and bow twice.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment and prohibition of necromancy (Deut. 18:10-12); the dead cannot hear or receive worship.

items.text: When the announcement concerns your own event, come forward between the stairs and bow twice after the prayer.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 告事儀 2
items.quote: 當身進于兩階閒再拜。 — The person himself advances between the two stairs and bows twice.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment and prohibition of necromancy (Deut. 18:10-12); bowing to the dead is worship due to God alone.

items.text: When spirit tablets are moved, reinstalled, or carried elsewhere, perform an announcement rite using the first-day rite.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 告事儀 3
items.quote: 凡神主移安還安。或奉遷他處等事。則告祭用朔參之儀。 — Whenever spirit tablets are moved, reinstalled, or carried elsewhere, perform the announcement rite using the first-day rite.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment and prohibition of necromancy (Deut. 18:10-12); worship of tablets is idolatry.

items.text: When rearranging vessels or temporarily repairing leaks in the shrine without moving the tablets, perform an announcement rite using the moon-viewing rite.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 告事儀 3
items.quote: 若廟中改排器物鋪陳。或暫修雨漏處。而不動神主之事。則告祭用望參之儀。 — If rearranging vessels or temporarily repairing leaks without moving the tablets, perform the announcement rite using the moon-viewing rite.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment and prohibition of necromancy (Deut. 18:10-12); announcing to spirits denies God's sovereignty.

items.text: When your wife bears the legitimate eldest son, present him to the ancestors after one month, standing before the incense table and announcing his birth.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 告事儀 4
items.quote: 主人生嫡長子。則滿月而見。如上儀。但不用祝。 — When the master's wife bears the first legitimate son, after one month present him to the ancestors as above, but without the prayer.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment and prohibition of necromancy (Deut. 18:10-12); children belong to God, not ancestors.

items.text: After the master announces the birth, hold the child and advance to stand between the two stairs, then bow twice before the ancestors.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 告事儀 4
items.quote: 主婦抱子進立於兩階之間。再拜。 — The wife, holding the child, advances and stands between the two stairs and bows twice.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment and prohibition of necromancy (Deut. 18:10-12); bowing to the dead is worship due to God alone.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 擊蒙要訣 5 · 事親章第五 사친장 · Serving Parents · 事親章 1 … 事親章 8

items.text: Receive your body, life, and breath from your parents; do not consider them your own, but repay their grace with filial devotion.
items.quote: 此身非我私物。乃父母之遺氣也。 — This body is not my private possession, but the vital energy left by my parents.

items.text: In every matter, do not act on your own; first ask your parents' command and act only after they allow it. If they refuse what is permissible, plead gently; if they still refuse, do not force your own wish.
items.quote: 一事一行。毋敢自專。必稟命而後行。 — In every single matter and action, do not presume to act on your own; always report and ask for their command before acting.

items.text: At dawn, wash, dress, and go to your parents' bedside; in a soft voice ask if they are warm or cold and whether they are well. In the evening, go to their room, straighten their bedding, and check its warmth or coolness. Serve them all day with a cheerful face and respectful answers.
items.quote: 每日未明而起。盥櫛衣帶。就父母寢所。下氣怡聲。問燠寒安否。昏則詣寢所。定其褥席。察其溫涼。 — Every day rise before dawn, wash, comb, dress, and go to your parents' bedroom; with lowered breath and pleasant voice, ask if they are warm or cold and whether they are well; at dusk go to their bedroom, arrange their mat and bedding, and check its warmth and coolness.

items.text: When going out, bow and take leave; when returning, bow and report yourself.
items.quote: 出入。必拜辭拜謁。 — When going out or coming in, always bow in farewell or in greeting.

items.text: Personally manage the household affairs and obtain savory food for your parents; if they firmly refuse your taking over, still assist and do your utmost to provide delicacies they enjoy.
items.quote: 必須躬幹家事。自備甘旨。然後子職乃修。 — You must personally manage household affairs and yourself prepare sweet and savory food; then the duty of a son is fulfilled.

items.text: Treat your parents with utmost respect: do not sit or lie where they sit or lie, do not receive private guests where they receive guests, and do not mount or dismount where they mount or dismount.
items.quote: 必須痛洗舊習。極其尊敬。父母所坐臥處。子不敢坐臥。 — You must thoroughly wash away old habits and show utmost respect; where your parents sit or lie, a son dare not sit or lie.

items.text: If your parents' wishes are not contrary to righteousness, anticipate and follow them without the slightest deviation; if they are harmful, remonstrate with a gentle face and soft voice, repeatedly explaining until they listen.
items.quote: 父母之志。若非害於義理。則當先意承順。毫忽不可違。 — If your parents' intentions are not harmful to righteousness, then you should anticipate their wishes and obey; not the slightest bit may be disobeyed.

items.text: When your parents are ill, set aside all other affairs and devote yourself only to consulting doctors and preparing medicine; when the illness ends, return to normal.
items.quote: 父母有疾。心憂色沮。捨置他事。只以問醫劑藥爲務。 — When your parents are ill, be worried and downcast, set aside other matters, and make it your sole task to ask after physicians and prepare medicine.

items.text: At every moment remember your parents; do not behave carelessly, speak without order, or idle away the day; serve them with all sincerity and effort as if time is running out.
items.quote: 日用之間。一毫之頃。不忘父母。然後乃名爲孝。 — In daily life, at every single moment, do not forget your parents; only then can you be called filial.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 祭儀鈔 · 薦獻儀 · Rite of Seasonal Offerings · 祭儀鈔 薦獻儀 1 … 祭儀鈔 薦獻儀 2

items.text: Offer seasonal foods on the customary festival days (the fifteenth of the first month, the third of the third month, the fifth of the fifth month, the fifteenth of the sixth month, the seventh of the seventh month, the fifteenth of the eighth month, the ninth of the ninth month, and the La day), following the rite of the new and full moon visits.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Jesa Uicho, Cheonheonui 1
items.quote: 俗節。獻以時食。如朔參之儀。 — On customary festivals, offer seasonal foods as in the monthly offering rite.

items.text: When there is new produce, offer it: if it can be made into a meal, prepare dishes and offer as in the monthly rite; if not, at morning visit open the spirit tablet box and offer it alone, burning incense and bowing twice; do not wait for the regular festival days.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Jesa Uicho, Cheonheonui 1-2
items.quote: 有新物則薦。 — When there is new produce, offer it.

items.text: Before offering new produce to the ancestors, do not eat it; offer it first, except when staying in another region.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Jesa Uicho, Cheonheonui 2
items.quote: 凡新物。未薦前不可先食。 — For all new produce, before offering, you must not eat it.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 祭儀鈔 · 時祭儀 · Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice · 祭儀鈔 時祭儀 13 … 祭儀鈔 時祭儀 18

items.text: Bow twice to take leave of the spirits; if old or sick and resting elsewhere, come in after receiving the meat and bow as well.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 13
items.quote: 主人以下皆再拜。... 老疾不堪行禮。前休于他處者。亦於受胙後入就位。辭神。 — The master and all below bow twice; the old and sick who rested elsewhere also come in after receiving the meat and bow.
items.conflict: venerating the dead is forbidden; bowing to spirits is necromancy (Deut 18:11)

items.text: With his wife, carry each spirit tablet back into its box and return it to the ancestral hall.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 14
items.quote: 主人主婦升。各奉主納于櫝。... 奉歸祠堂。如來儀。 — Master and mistress carry each tablet into its box and return to the ancestral hall.
items.conflict: venerating the dead is forbidden; handling spirit tablets is idolatry (Deut 7:25)

items.text: Remove the sacrificial food into ordinary vessels; wash and store the sacrificial vessels.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 15
items.quote: 撤祭饌傳于燕器。滌祭器而藏之。 — Remove the sacrificial food into ordinary vessels; wash and store the vessels.

items.text: Distribute the sacrificial food to relatives and friends; gather the sons and younger kin to sit and share the wine and food.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 16
items.quote: 分祭物送于親友家。會親賓子弟敍坐。以酒饌酬酢而罷。 — Distribute the sacrificial food to relatives and friends; gather sons and younger kin to share wine and food.

items.text: Offer a separate portion of food to the earth god after the family rites in spring and winter.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 18
items.quote: 別具一分之饌。... 家廟禮畢。乃祭土神。 — Set aside a portion of food; after the family rites, sacrifice to the earth god.
items.conflict: offering to a local deity is idolatry; worship God alone (Exod 20:3)

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 祭儀鈔 · 喪服中行祭儀 · Performing Sacrifices While in Mourning · 祭儀鈔 喪服中行祭儀 1

items.text: During the three-year mourning, before burial, suspend the ancestral shrine sacrifices according to the ancient rites.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 喪服中行祭儀 1
items.quote: 未葬前則準禮廢祭 — Before burial, according to propriety, suspend the sacrifices.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden; worship God alone (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: After the final wailing, for seasonal and anniversary sacrifices (and grave sacrifices), have one in lighter mourning offer them with reduced dishes, one libation, no prayer, and no partaking of the blessed food.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 喪服中行祭儀 1
items.quote: 卒哭後...使服輕者行薦...只一獻 — After the final wailing... have one in lighter mourning offer... only one libation.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden; worship God alone (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: After burial in one-year or nine-month mourning, perform the sacrifices as in ordinary times, but do not receive the blessed food.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 喪服中行祭儀 1
items.quote: 期，大功則葬後。當祭如平時。（但不受胙） — For one-year and nine-month mourning, after burial, sacrifice as usual, but do not receive the blessed food.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden; worship God alone (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Before burial in one-year or nine-month mourning, omit the seasonal sacrifices; perform the death anniversary and grave sacrifices briefly as described.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 喪服中行祭儀 1
items.quote: 未葬前。時祭可廢。忌祭，墓祭。略行如上儀 — Before burial, seasonal sacrifices may be omitted; anniversary and grave sacrifices may be performed briefly as above.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden; worship God alone (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Before the mourning garments are completed in three-month or five-month mourning, suspend sacrifices; even death anniversary sacrifices may not be performed.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 喪服中行祭儀 1
items.quote: 緦，小功則成服前廢祭。（五服未成服前。雖忌祭。亦不可行也。） — For three-month and five-month mourning, before completing the garments, suspend sacrifices; even anniversary sacrifices may not be performed.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden; worship God alone (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: After the mourning garments are completed in three-month or five-month mourning, perform sacrifices as in ordinary times, but do not receive the blessed food.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 喪服中行祭儀 1
items.quote: 成服後則當祭如平時。（但不受胙） — After the garments are completed, sacrifice as usual, but do not receive the blessed food.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is forbidden; worship God alone (Exod 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12).

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 祭儀鈔 · 參禮儀 · Rite of Visiting (New and Full Moon) · 祭儀鈔 參禮儀 1

items.text: Prepare for the rite: the day before, sweep and purify, keep vigil; early next morning, open the shrine and set out the offerings.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 參禮儀 1
items.quote: 前一日。灑埽齋宿。厥明。夙興開祠堂門。設茅沙於香案前。每位設饌。 — The day before, sweep and purify and keep vigil; at dawn open the shrine and set out offerings.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship; violates the first commandment (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: Bring out the tablets of the deceased male ancestors and place them before the chest.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 參禮儀 1
items.quote: 主人盥帨。升啓櫝。奉諸考神主置於櫝前。 — The master washes hands, opens the chest, and takes out the tablets of the fathers and places them before the chest.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship; violates the first commandment (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: Bring out the tablets of the deceased female ancestors and place them.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 參禮儀 1
items.quote: 主婦盥帨升。奉諸妣神主置于考東。 — The mistress washes hands, ascends, and takes out the tablets of the mothers and places them east of the fathers.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship; violates the first commandment (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: Offer incense and pour a libation to the ancestors.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 參禮儀 1
items.quote: 焚香再拜。酹于茅上。 — Burn incense and bow; pour wine on the sand.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship; violates the first commandment (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: Offer wine at each place and bow before the ancestors.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 參禮儀 1
items.quote: 主人升。執酒注斟于各位前盞。立於香卓前再拜。 — The master fills the wine cups at each place and bows before the incense table.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship; violates the first commandment (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: Join in bowing to greet the ancestors and send them off.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, 祭儀鈔 參禮儀 1
items.quote: 與在位者皆再拜以參神。...與在位者皆再拜。辭神而退。 — All in their places bow twice to greet the spirits... bow twice to send them off.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship; violates the first commandment (Exod 20:3-5).

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 祭儀鈔 · 忌祭儀 · Rite of the Death-Day Sacrifice · 祭儀鈔 忌祭儀 1 … 祭儀鈔 忌祭儀 4

items.text: Keep the death-day of the departed with a full sacrifice: purify yourself, set out the offerings, bring forth the spirit tablet, and present the wine and food in order.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, 祭儀鈔 忌祭儀 1-4
items.quote: 主人升。焚香跪告于所祭之主曰。敢請神主。出就正寢。恭伸追慕。 — The master ascends, burns incense, kneels and tells the spirit tablet, "I presume to request the spirit tablet to be brought out to the main hall to express my longing."
items.conflict: Offering sacrifices to the dead is idolatrous (Ex 20:3-5; Deut 18:10-12)

items.text: On the death-day, go to the family shrine, bow before the spirit tablet, and follow the order of the sacrifice.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, 祭儀鈔 忌祭儀 1-4
items.quote: 詣祠堂敍立。再拜訖。 — Go to the shrine, stand in order, bow twice.
items.conflict: Bowing to a spirit tablet violates the second commandment against images (Ex 20:4-5)

items.text: Weep aloud with your brothers in full sorrow on the death-day of your father or mother.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, 祭儀鈔 忌祭儀 1-4
items.quote: 讀祝畢。祝興主人兄弟哭盡哀。 — After reading the prayer, the master and brothers weep to full sorrow.

items.text: On the death-day, do not drink wine, eat meat, or listen to music; wear mourning clothes and sleep in the outer room.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, 祭儀鈔 忌祭儀 1-4
items.quote: 是日。不飮酒。不食肉。不聽樂。變服以居。夕寢于外。 — On that day: no wine, no meat, no music; change clothes and live in them; in the evening sleep outside.

items.text: After the death-day sacrifice, do not receive the blessing portion or eat the sacrificial leftovers.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, 祭儀鈔 忌祭儀 1-4
items.quote: 但不受胙。不餕。 — But do not receive the blessing portion, do not eat the leftovers.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 擊蒙要訣 8 · 居家章第八 거가장 · Living in the Household · 居家章 1 … 居家章 10

items.text: Rule the household by strictly observing propriety and law, leading wife, children, and all members.
items.quote: 凡居家。當謹守禮法。以率妻子及家衆。

items.text: Control spending according to income; provide food and clothing to all above and below according to status, and keep a surplus for emergencies.
items.quote: 制財用之節。量入而爲出。稱家之有無。以給上下之衣食及吉凶之費。

items.text: Love each other as one body; share food, clothing, and possessions, not letting one go hungry while another is full.
items.quote: 兄弟。同受父母遺體。與我如一身。視之當無彼我之閒。飮食衣服有無。皆當共之。

items.text: If a brother does wrong, admonish him sincerely, gradually explain with reason, and do not suddenly show harsh words or angry looks.
items.quote: 兄弟若有不善之行。則當積誠忠諫。漸喩以理。期於感悟。不可遽加厲色拂言。以失其和也。

items.text: Be harmonious and govern with righteousness; maintain courteous respect, not over-familiarity.
items.quote: 必須夫和而制以義。夫婦之間。不失禮敬。

items.text: Be submissive and accept with uprightness; maintain courteous respect.
items.quote: 妻順而承以正。夫婦之間。不失禮敬。

items.text: From the time he begins to understand, guide him to good; if not taught young, it is hard later; teach according to the Elementary Learning.
items.quote: 生子。自稍有知識時。當導之以善。若幼而不敎。至於旣長。則習非放心。敎之甚難。敎之之序。當依小學。

items.text: Love and teach your brother's children as your own, without partiality.
items.quote: 兄弟之子。猶我子也。其愛之。其敎之。當均一。不可有輕重厚薄也。

items.text: Care for their hunger and cold; give them food and clothing so they are settled.
items.quote: 必須軫念飢寒。資給衣食。使得其所。

items.text: If they do wrong, first teach them diligently; only if they do not change, then beat them, so they know the punishment is for instruction, not hate.
items.quote: 有過惡。則先須勤勤敎誨。使之改革。敎之不改。然後乃施楚撻。

items.text: Separate male and female servants; do not allow male servants to enter inner quarters without orders; see that female servants have fixed husbands; if immorality continues, expel them; maintain harmony among servants.
items.quote: 治家當以禮法。辨別內外。雖婢僕。男女不可混處。男僕非有所使令。則不可輒入內。女僕皆當使有定夫。不可使淫亂。若淫亂不止者。則當黜使別居。婢僕當令和睦。

items.text: Arrange capping and marriage ceremonies according to family rites, not popular custom.
items.quote: 冠婚之制。當依家禮。不可苟且從俗。

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 擊蒙要訣 9 · 接人章第九 접인장 · Dealing with Others · 接人章 1 … 接人章 9

items.text: In all dealings, be harmonious and respectful; treat those twice your age as fathers, ten years older as older brothers, five years older with added respect; never rely on learning to be arrogant or browbeat others.
items.quote: 年長以倍則父事之。十年以長則兄事之。五年以長。亦稍加敬。 — Treat those twice your age as fathers, ten years older as older brothers, five years older with added respect.

items.text: Choose as friends only those who love learning and goodness—strict, upright, honest men—and humbly receive their correction; have nothing to do with the indolent, playful, flattering, or crooked.
items.quote: 必取好學好善方嚴直諒之人。與之同處。虛受規戒。 — Must choose friends who love learning and goodness, strict, upright, honest; dwell with them and humbly receive their correction.

items.text: Draw near to good villagers and share your heart with them; do not revile the bad or expose their shameful deeds, but treat them coolly and, if previously known, only exchange greetings and let the relationship fade.
items.quote: 鄕人之善者。則必須親近通情。而鄕人之不善者。亦不可惡言揚其陋行。 — Be close to good villagers; do not revile bad ones or expose their ugly deeds.

items.text: If your heart is set on learning, seek out those who love learning, and do not keep company with those whose days are filled with idle chatter and crowded, noisy houses.
items.quote: 若我志於學問。則我必求學問之士。學問之士。亦必求我矣。 — If I set my mind on learning, I must seek learned men, and learned men will seek me.

items.text: Bow to your father's close friends, to villagers at least fifteen years older, to officials ten years your senior, and to villagers twenty years older; keep an attitude that lowers yourself and honors others.
items.quote: 父之執友則當拜。洞內年長十五歲以上者當拜。爵階堂上而長於我十年以上者當拜。鄕人年長二十歲以上者當拜。 — Bow to father's close friends, to villagers fifteen years older, to ranked officials ten years older, and to villagers twenty years older.

items.text: When slandered, examine yourself; if there is fault, repent and change; if the report is exaggerated or false, treat it as wind passing by and do not argue—improving yourself is the only answer.
items.quote: 若聞過自辨。嘵嘵然不置。必欲置身於無過之地。則其過愈深。而取謗益重矣。 — If hearing of a fault you defend yourself and won't stop, wanting to appear blameless, your fault deepens and slander grows heavier.

items.text: In attendance on teachers and elders, ask about the meaning of what is hard to understand; before village elders, be careful, respectful, and answer honestly.
items.quote: 凡侍先生長者。當質問義理難曉處。以明其學。侍鄕黨長老。當小心恭謹。不放言語。有問則敬對以實。 — When attending teachers and elders, ask about difficult principles; before village elders, be cautious, reverent, answer truthfully.

items.text: With friends, discuss only right principles and written learning; never speak of worldly vulgarities, government successes or failures, magistrates' worth, or other men's faults.
items.quote: 與朋友處。當以道義講磨。只談文字義理而已。 — With friends, discuss the Way and righteousness, only letters and principle.

items.text: With villagers, though you answer their questions, never speak coarse or lewd words; though you keep dignified, never show a conceited air—only encourage them with good words to turn to learning.
items.quote: 與鄕人處。雖隨問應答。而終不可發鄙褻之言。雖莊栗自持。而切不可存矜高之色。 — With villagers, though you answer as asked, never utter vulgar or lewd words; though solemn, never wear a proud look.

items.text: With those younger than you, earnestly teach filial piety, brotherly respect, loyalty, and trust, so that good hearts are stirred.
items.quote: 與幼者處。當諄諄言孝悌忠信。使發善心。 — With the young, earnestly speak of filial piety, brotherly respect, loyalty, and trust, so that a good heart is awakened.

items.text: Keep a heart that is warm, respectful, loving, and eager to benefit and help others; let not a hair of intent to harm or injure remain in your mind; first root out selfish desire, then you can learn benevolence.
items.quote: 常以溫恭慈愛惠人濟物爲心。若其侵人害物之事。則一毫不可留於心曲。 — Always keep a heart of warmth, reverence, kindness, love that benefits and helps others; let not a shred of intent to harm remain in your heart.

items.text: As a scholar living in the village, do not go in and out of government offices except on public business, ceremonial visits, or unavoidable necessity; even if the magistrate is a close relative, do not visit him often; and never make unjust requests.
items.quote: 居鄕之士。非公事禮見及不得已之故。則不可出入官府。邑宰雖至親。亦不可數數往見。 — A village scholar must not frequent government offices except for public business, ceremonial visits, or necessity; even if the magistrate is a close relative, do not visit often.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 祭儀鈔 · 時祭儀 · Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice · 祭儀鈔 時祭儀 1 … 祭儀鈔 時祭儀 12

items.text: Announce the upcoming seasonal sacrifice to the ancestors at the shrine three days beforehand.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 1-12
items.quote: 孝曾孫某。將以某月某日。祗薦歲事于曾祖考妣，祖考妣，考妣。敢告。 — The filial great-grandson so-and-so will on such-and-such a day reverently present the annual offerings to the great-grandfather and great-grandmother, grandfather and grandmother, father and mother. He dares to announce.
items.conflict: offering to ancestors; Deut 18:11

items.text: Invite the spirit tablets of the ancestors out to the main hall for the sacrifice.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 1-12
items.quote: 敢請神主出就正寢 — dare to ask the spirit tablets to go out to the main hall.
items.conflict: offering to ancestors; Deut 18:11

items.text: Perform the first libation offering to the ancestors.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 1-12
items.quote: 主人升。詣曾祖位前 — the host ascends and goes before the great-grandfather's place.
items.conflict: offering to ancestors; Deut 18:11

items.text: Perform the second libation offering to the ancestors.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 1-12
items.quote: 行亞獻禮。主婦爲之。 — Perform the second offering; the main wife does it.
items.conflict: offering to ancestors; Deut 18:11

items.text: Perform the final libation offering to the ancestors.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 1-12
items.quote: 行終獻禮。兄弟之長，或長男或親賓爲之。 — Perform the final offering; the eldest brother, or eldest son, or a guest does it.
items.conflict: offering to ancestors; Deut 18:11

items.text: Receive the blessing portion from the ancestor's offering.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 1-12
items.quote: 祖考命工祝。承致多福于汝孝孫。 — The ancestors command the invoker to convey many blessings to you, filial grandson.
items.conflict: offering to ancestors; Deut 18:11

items.text: Lead the men of the household in fasting outside before the sacrifice.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 1-12
items.quote: 主人帥衆丈夫齋于外 — the host leads all the men to fast outside.
items.conflict: offering to ancestors; Deut 18:11

items.text: Lead the women of the household in fasting inside before the sacrifice.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 1-12
items.quote: 主婦帥衆婦女齋于內 — the main wife leads all the women to fast inside.
items.conflict: offering to ancestors; Deut 18:11

items.text: If the main wife is unable, the most senior uncle or brother performs the second offering.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi, Rite of the Seasonal Sacrifice 1-12
items.quote: 主婦有故，則諸父若兄弟中最尊者爲之 — if the main wife has a reason, then the most senior among uncles or brothers performs it.
items.conflict: offering to ancestors; Deut 18:11

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 祭儀鈔 · 墓祭儀 · Rite of the Grave Sacrifice · 祭儀鈔 墓祭儀 1 … 祭儀鈔 墓祭儀 4

items.text: Perform the grave sacrifice on the four named days; observe two days of lesser fasting and one day of strict fasting; prepare food portions for each grave as in the death-day rite, and prepare an extra portion to sacrifice to the land god.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi 祭儀鈔 墓祭儀 1
items.quote: 墓祭。依俗制。行于四名日。 — Perform the grave sacrifice according to custom on the four named days.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is idolatry; the dead cannot hear or receive offerings; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: On the morning of the rite, put on the plain cap and dark clothes, lead the officiants to the grave, bow twice, walk around the grave three times in sorrow, cutting away weeds and sweeping it clean, then return and bow again.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi 祭儀鈔 墓祭儀 1
items.quote: 主人以下玄冠，素服，黑帶。帥執事者詣墓所。再拜奉行。 — The master and those below him, in dark caps and plain clothes, lead the officiants to the grave and perform the rite.
items.conflict: Tending a grave is permissible, but acts of worship and veneration of the dead are forbidden.

items.text: Arrange the food, call down the spirits, bow, and make the first offering; at the first offering, place the spoon upright in the rice and set the chopsticks straight.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi 祭儀鈔 墓祭儀 2
items.quote: 陳饌，降神，參神，初獻。 — Present the food, call down the spirits, bow, and make the first offering.
items.conflict: Calling down spirits and offering food to the dead is necromancy and blasphemy.

items.text: Speak the prayer appropriate to the season: at Cold Food say, "The rain and dew have already moistened"; then say, "Looking upon and sweeping your tomb, I cannot overcome my longing."
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi 祭儀鈔 墓祭儀 2
items.quote: 但祝詞曰。氣序流易。靑陽載回。 — But the prayer says: "The season has turned and spring returns."
items.conflict: Praying to the dead assumes they can hear and help, which Scripture denies.

items.text: Make the second and third offerings; after the third, remove the soup and present boiled water; then bid the spirits farewell and clear away.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi 祭儀鈔 墓祭儀 2
items.quote: 亞獻，終獻，辭神。乃徹。 — The second and third offerings, farewell to the spirits, then clearing away.
items.conflict: Ritual offerings to the dead are vain worship and dishonor God.

items.text: Regulate the grave sacrifice: on Cold Food and Harvest Moon, offer abundant food, read the prayer, and sacrifice to the land god; on New Year and Dano, offer simple food, make only one offering without reading the prayer, and do not sacrifice to the land god.
items.citation: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, Jeuichi 祭儀鈔 墓祭儀 4
items.quote: 寒食，秋夕具盛饌，讀祝文；正朝，端午略備饌，一獻無祝。 — On Cold Food and Harvest Moon, prepare abundant food and read the prayer; on New Year and Dano, prepare simple food, one offering, no prayer.
items.conflict: Even a simplified ancestor ritual is still idolatrous worship of the dead.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 擊蒙要訣 6 · 喪制章第六 상제장 · Mourning Regulations · 喪制章 1 … 喪制章 16

items.text: Ask elders learned in rites about any doubtful point and carry out the mourning rites fully.
items.quote: 若有疑晦處。則質問于先生長者識禮處。必盡其禮可也。 — If there are doubtful points, ask elders who know the rites and carry them out fully.

items.text: If your wife dies and you live, act as chief mourner and use the husband-to-wife form in all memorial addresses.
items.quote: 母喪。父在則父爲喪主。凡祝辭。皆當用夫告妻之例也。 — In the mother's funeral, if the father is alive, the father is chief mourner; in all prayers use the husband-addressing-wife pattern.

items.text: When a condoler bows to the spirit seat and leaves, come out from your mourning place and bow twice in return, weeping.
items.quote: 弔客拜靈座而出。則喪者當出自喪次。向弔客再拜而哭可也。 — When the condoler bows to the spirit seat and leaves, the mourner should come out and bow twice to the condoler and weep.

items.text: Do not take off the hempen mourning garments except for illness or unavoidable work.
items.quote: 衰絰。非疾病服役。則不可脫也。 — The mourning garments must not be removed except for illness or service.

items.text: For a parent's death, follow the prescribed mourning diet: gruel at first, then coarse food and water, vegetables and fruit only after the lesser anniversary, unless illness prevents it; do not force extra fasting to deceive your parent.
items.quote: 父母之喪。成服之日。始食粥。卒哭之日。始疏食水飮。不食菜果。小祥之後。始食菜果。 — For a parent's death, begin gruel on completing clothes, then coarse food and water, no vegetables or fruit until the lesser anniversary.

items.text: If you cannot carry out all the rites after returning the spirit home, do not go home to live with wife and children; keep the old custom of staying at the grave hut.
items.quote: 凡喪親者。自度一一從禮。無毫分虧欠。則當依禮返魂。如或未然。則當依舊俗廬墓可也。 — Whoever mourns a parent, if you can follow every rite without deficiency, return the spirit; if not, keep the old custom of dwelling at the grave.

items.text: In mourning, rather than having full rites with insufficient grief, have full grief even if the rites are incomplete; mourn to the utmost of sorrow and respect.
items.quote: 凡喪。與其哀不足而禮有餘也。不若禮不足而哀有餘也。喪事。不過盡其哀敬而已。 — In mourning, better too much grief than too much ritual; mourning is only exhausting grief and respect.

items.text: In mourning your parents, exert yourself to the utmost: three days without slackening, three months without remiss, a year of sorrow, three years of worry; force yourself to this standard if you fall short.
items.quote: 三日不怠。三月不懈。期悲哀。三年憂。此是居喪之則也。 — Three days without slack, three months without remiss, a year of sorrow, three years of worry: this is the standard for dwelling in mourning.

items.text: Do not ruin your health by excessive grief and self-denial; harming your body in mourning is unfilial.
items.quote: 過於哀毀。羸疾已作。而不忍從權。以至滅性者或有之。深可惜也。是故。毀瘠傷生。君子謂之不孝。 — Some ruin health through excessive grief and will not compromise, even destroying life; wasting away is called unfilial by the noble.

items.text: When you hear of a relative's death while elsewhere, set up a seat and weep; if you cannot attend, observe the appointed days for completing the mourning clothes.
items.quote: 若他處聞訃。則設位而哭。若奔喪。則至家而成服。若不奔喪。則四日成服。 — If you hear the death elsewhere, set up a seat and weep; if you cannot attend, complete the clothes after four days.

items.text: On the first day of each month while in mourning, set up a seat, wear your mourning clothes, and gather to weep; at the end of the period, remove them at that gathering.
items.quote: 每月朔日。設位。服其服而會哭。月數旣滿。則於次月朔日。設位服其服。會哭而除之。 — On each month's first day, set a seat, wear mourning clothes and gather to weep; when months are complete, on next month's first day remove them.

items.text: For nine-month and heavier mourning, do not go out or visit others before the burial; devote yourself to funeral preparations and studying the rites.
items.quote: 未葬前。非有故。不可出入。亦不可弔人。常以治喪講禮爲事。 — Before burial, without reason do not go out or in, nor condole others; always occupy yourself with funeral matters and rites.

work: Gyeongmong Yogyeol, with the appended Jeuichi
heading: 擊蒙要訣 7 · 祭禮章第七 제례장 · Ancestral Rites · 祭禮章 1 … 祭禮章 9

items.text: Establish the ancestral shrine, set up sacrificial land and vessels, and preside over the rites as head of the line.
items.quote: 必立祠堂。以奉先主。置祭田。具祭器。宗子主之。 — Establish the shrine to serve the ancestral tablets, set up sacrificial fields and vessels; the lineage heir directs it.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; do not serve ancestors as spirits.

items.text: Every morning do reverence before the shrine and announce your departures and returns.
items.quote: 主祠堂者。每晨。謁于大門之內。再拜。出入必告。 — The shrine keeper bows twice inside the gate each morning and reports comings and goings.
items.conflict: Prayer and worship are directed to God alone, not to the dead.

items.text: When fire, flood, or robbery occurs, first rescue the shrine and its tablets, then the sacrificial vessels, before any family property.
items.quote: 或有水火盜賊。則先救祠堂。遷神主，遺書。次及祭器。然後及家財。 — In disaster, rescue the shrine, tablets, and writings before other goods.
items.conflict: God's worship and love of neighbor take priority over material symbols.

items.text: On New Year's Day, the solstice, the first and fifteenth of each month, and customary holidays, perform the appropriate rites and offer seasonal foods.
items.quote: 正至朔望則參。俗節則薦以時食。 — At New Year, solstice, new and full moons, do obeisance; on festivals offer seasonal foods.
items.conflict: Religious observance belongs to God alone; do not offer food to spirits.

items.text: Before seasonal and death-anniversary sacrifices, keep the prescribed periods of abstinence and concentration, avoiding all defiling things and fixing your mind on the deceased.
items.quote: 散齊者。不弔喪。不問疾。不茹葷。飲酒不得至亂。致齊者。不聽樂。不出入。專心想念所祭之人。 — Abstain from mourning visits, illness, meat, disorderly drinking; focus only on the deceased.
items.conflict: Purity rituals for the dead detract from Christ's cleansing and from communion with God alone.

items.text: Exhaust the rites in mourning and the sincerity in sacrifice for your deceased parents, for there is no other way to express your lifelong sorrow.
items.quote: 喪祭二禮最是人子致誠處也已沒之親不可追養若非喪盡其禮祭盡其誠則終天之痛無事可寓 — Funeral and sacrifice are where a son shows utmost sincerity to departed parents.
items.conflict: Filial piety does not require honoring the dead as spirits; trust God with them.

items.text: If your father does not want to follow the correct rites, tactfully explain and persuade him, but do not force.
items.quote: 若父兄不欲。則當委曲陳達。期於歸正。 — If father or elder brother objects, gently reason and hope for correction.
items.conflict: Do not promote ancestor worship; honor parents without participating in false religion.

items.text: If your elder brother does not want to follow the correct rites, tactfully explain and persuade him, but do not force.
items.quote: 若父兄不欲。則當委曲陳達。期於歸正。 — If father or elder brother objects, gently reason and hope for correction.
items.conflict: Do not urge siblings into idolatrous practices; show respect without false worship.

items.text: Carefully examine and follow the copied rites and diagrams, and do not let each household perform differently.
items.quote: 玆鈔祭禮。附錄于後。且爲之圖。須詳審倣行。 — These rites and diagrams are appended; study and follow them closely.
items.conflict: Uniform human traditions must not supplant the Word of God in worship.
